def poissonNonzeroFrequency (t x : ℝ) (h : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  if h = 0 then 0 else
    t • (𝓕 dyadicCutoffSchwartz) (t * h) * fourier h (x : UnitAddCircle)

@[simp] theorem poissonNonzeroFrequency_zero (t x : ℝ) :
    poissonNonzeroFrequency t x 0 = 0 := rfl

selected_primitive_definitions.source:
def MediumAtom.complexCRTSmoothZeroPart (d : MediumAtom) : ℂ :=
  ∑ l ∈ d.complexRowLabels, ∑ l' ∈ d.complexRowLabels,
    d.complexBetaCoefficient l * star (d.complexBetaCoefficient l') *
      (if ComplexCRT.Compatible (complexFactorModulus l.1)
        (complexFactorModulus l'.1) l.2 l'.2 then
          ((d.U / (complexFactorModulus l.1).lcm (complexFactorModulus l'.1)) *
            CommonSmoothCutoff.cutoffMass : ℝ) else 0)

def MediumAtom.complexCRTSmoothNonzeroPart (d : MediumAtom) : ℂ :=
  ∑ l ∈ d.complexRowLabels, ∑ l' ∈ d.complexRowLabels,
    d.complexBetaCoefficient l * star (d.complexBetaCoefficient l') *
      (if ComplexCRT.Compatible (complexFactorModulus l.1)
        (complexFactorModulus l'.1) l.2 l'.2 then
          (∑' h : ℤ, CommonSmoothCutoff.poissonNonzeroFrequency
            (d.U / (complexFactorModulus l.1).lcm (complexFactorModulus l'.1))
            ((ComplexCRT.residue (complexFactorModulus l.1)
              (complexFactorModulus l'.1) l.2 l'.2 d.residue : ℝ) /
                (complexFactorModulus l.1).lcm (complexFactorModulus l'.1)) h).re
      else 0 : ℝ)

structure MediumAtom where
  U : ℝ
  V : ℝ
  Q1 : ℝ
  Q2 : ℝ
  Q3 : ℝ
  residue : ℤ
  intervalLo : ℝ
  intervalHi : ℝ
  alpha : ℕ → ℂ
  beta : ℕ → ℂ
  gamma1 : ℕ → ℂ
  gamma2 : ℕ → ℂ
  gamma3 : ℕ → ℂ

def UniformAuxiliarySW {ι : Type*} (F : ι → MediumAtom) (C0 : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ x0 : ℝ, 1 < x0 ∧
    ∀ i : ι, x0 ≤ (F i).scale → ∀ k q b : ℕ,
      1 ≤ k → 1 ≤ q → Nat.Coprime b q →
      ‖(F i).auxSWError k q b‖ ≤
        C * (F i).U * ((k.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ C0) /
          (Real.log (F i).scale) ^ A

selected_primitive_definitions.name: MediumAtom.discrepancy
selected_primitive_definitions.source:
def MediumAtom.discrepancy (d : MediumAtom) (q : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, ∑ m ∈ d.betaCarrier,
    d.alpha n * d.beta m *
      ((if (((n * m : ℕ) : ℤ) % (q : ℤ) = d.residue % (q : ℤ))
          then (1 : ℂ) else 0) -
        (if Nat.Coprime (n * m) q then (1 : ℂ) else 0) / (Nat.totient q : ℂ))

selected_primitive_definitions.name: MediumAtom.signedError
selected_primitive_definitions.source:
def MediumAtom.signedError (d : MediumAtom) : ℂ :=
  ∑ q1 ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1, ∑ q2 ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2,
    ∑ q3 ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3,
      d.gamma1 q1 * d.gamma2 q2 * d.gamma3 q3 * d.discrepancy (q1 * q2 * q3)

selected_primitive_definitions.name: MediumAdmissible
selected_primitive_definitions.source:
def MediumAdmissible (B : ℕ) (σ κ c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ d.U ∧ 1 ≤ d.V ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q1 ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q2 ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q3 ∧
  Real.exp (Real.exp 1) < d.scale ∧
  c0 * d.scale ≤ (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ≤ d.scale ^ (1 + κ) ∧
  d.Q1 < d.U * d.scale ^ (-σ) ∧
  d.U ^ 2 * d.Q2 * d.Q3 ^ 2 < d.scale ^ (1 - 8 * σ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ^ (7 / 32 : ℝ) * d.U * d.Q1 * d.Q2 ^ 5 * d.Q3 ^ 2 <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  d.U ^ (1 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q1 *
      d.Q2 ^ (5 - 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q3 ^ (2 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, ‖d.alpha n‖ ≤ 1) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, d.alpha n ≠ 0 → ∀ p : ℕ,
    Nat.Prime p → p ∣ n →
      d.scale ^ (1 / (Real.log (Real.log d.scale)) ^ 3) < (p : ℝ)) ∧
  (∀ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ≤ (m.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ B) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1, ‖d.gamma1 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma1 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs)) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2, ‖d.gamma2 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma2 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs)) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3, ‖d.gamma3 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma3 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs))

def MediumAtom.commonSmoothCarrier (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ℕ :=

selected_primitive_definitions.name: Compatible
selected_primitive_definitions.source:
def Compatible (q r m1 m2 : ℕ) : Prop :=
  m1.Coprime q ∧ m2.Coprime r ∧ Nat.ModEq (q.gcd r) m1 m2

selected_primitive_definitions.name: residue
selected_primitive_definitions.source:
def residue (q r m1 m2 : ℕ) (a : ℤ) : ℤ :=
  if h : Compatible q r m1 m2 then
    Classical.choose (exists_product_crt_residue h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2 a)
  else 0

selected_primitive_definitions.name: productProgressionWeight
selected_primitive_definitions.source:
def productProgressionWeight (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ)
    (q r m1 m2 : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ S, if Int.ModEq q ((n : ℤ) * m1) a ∧
    Int.ModEq r ((n : ℤ) * m2) a then w n else 0

selected_primitive_definitions.name: constructedProgressionWeight
selected_primitive_definitions.source:
def constructedProgressionWeight (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ)
    (q r m1 m2 : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if Compatible q r m1 m2 then
    ∑ n ∈ S, if Int.ModEq (q.lcm r) (n : ℤ) (residue q r m1 m2 a)
      then w n else 0
  else 0

selected_primitive_definitions.name: MediumAtom.complexBetaCoefficient

def MediumAtom.complexBetaCoefficient (d : MediumAtom)
    (l : (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ) : ℂ := d.complexFactorGamma l.1 * d.beta l.2

semantic_checks.finding: For every MediumAtom without admissibility, the swap sets U_new=V_old, V_new=U_old, alpha_new=beta_old, beta_new=old alpha extended by zero from its original interval. The new interval (-1,floor(2V)] includes exactly all natural points of old betaCarrier. Q1,Q2,Q3, signed Int residue, gamma1/2/3, their complete physical products, and scale U*V are preserved.

The literal product-congruence minus primitive-coprime/totient kernel is symmetric in its two natural variables. Extension by zero and finite sum commutation preserve discrepancy at each q and signedError before norm or triangle inequalities. No original V/U dispersion component is reused.

Both AP-with-independent-coprime-sieve and primitive mean over padded paired beta equal the original alphaCarrier sums, so transposedPairedSWError equals original auxSWError for every k,q,b. The family statement keeps exactly forall real A>0, exists C>0,x0>1, all admissible-scale family indices and all k,q,b with k,q>=1 and b coprime q, with C*old U*divisor(k)^C0/log(old scale)^A. It neither adds paired-beta SW to original beta nor completes the provider global BetaCoprimeSWFamily adapter.

Original MediumAdmissible supplies beta bound tau_2(n)^B. Every old betaCarrier index is positive and <=2V. The fixed integer order 2^B is >=1 including B=0; pinned fouvryTau_power and second moment yield the literal sum norm(beta)^2 <= 2V*(1+log(2V))^((2^B)^2-1). No norm<=1 or roughness is asserted for original beta or for transposed outer alpha.

semantic_checks.finding: The transposed commonSmoothWeight is the fixed V-scaled cutoff, equals one on old betaCarrier and is supported in Icc 0 ceil(3V). Generic finite smoothed Cauchy applies without MediumAdmissible of the transposed atom. The larger moment prefactor is substituted only against the proved nonnegative complete W-2V+U bracket.

Each row has full original factor labels plus the padded old U index. Original Q>=1 yields positive physical moduli. Original active gamma gates imply original signed residue primitive for both complete moduli; inactive gamma rows vanish. Constructed CRT retains gcd compatibility and lcm with no pairwise-coprimality or squarefree assumptions.

The actual new W is expanded at old V on its single common carrier. The complete positive lcm and original moving signed residue feed the proved progression Poisson theorem. The full nonzero integer-frequency series and raw zero term remain exact. The final identity has the transposed primitive V/U terms literally, with no desired cancellation or analytic payment premise.
